text:
Cass (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — BrightBridge Learning listing went GA on LearnPort and the customer converted to an annual paid plan this morning. URL: https://learnport.market/brightbridge. Big win for the Edu catalog.
Ravi (AE): PO in, invoice sent. They added the Teacher Insights add-on (+$36k ARR). Thanks to Eli and Mai for the demo.
Mai (Customer Success): Onboarding kickoff done. Verified SSO, roster sync, and grading API. Note: their SIS uses mixed_id format; pushed a mapping note to the runbook.
Eli (Solutions): Mapping snippet added to repo and pushed to staging. For teams mapping mixed_id: set `SIS_MAP_MODE=mixed_to_numeric` in config. Also recommended routing heavy batch exports to Dedicated pool during nightly windows.
marketplace-bot: Listing status: staging -> published. Published at 09:05 UTC. Live URL: https://learnport.market/brightbridge (analytics tracking enabled).
Jo (Marketing): Nice! Can we get a 1-2 sentence quote and a screenshot of the insights dashboard for the case study? Planning blog + marketplace spotlight next week.
Ravi (AE): Reached out to their Head of Curriculum — got this quote: "Integrating Redwood with BrightBridge cut teacher prep time and surfaced actionable student insights." Sending to @Jo.
Tala (Legal): Confirmed marketplace addendum and demo consent signed. No extra IP clauses.
Mai (Customer Success): Uploaded onboarding playbook: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/brightbridge-onboard.md. Suggest CS enable short token TTL for sandbox demos (2h).
Jo (Marketing): I'll draft the case study and a marketplace card. Can someone drop the screenshot into the GH doc? I'll tag the assets channel.
Cass (Partnerships): Scheduling a co-marketing sync with BrightBridge for Wed. Adding Asana: "BrightBridge case study + marketplace spotlight" and assigning to @Jo, @Eli, @Mai.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace analytics event: first 12h impressions=980, installs=29.
Ravi (AE): FYI renewal included a 20% credit for early pilot conversion (noted in contract).
Tala (Legal): Noted on the contract.
Cass (Partnerships): Thanks team — great cross-functional effort. Closing thread, ping me if any blockers for assets or webinar. :tada:
